name: The Craft Cafe
heroSubtitle: Cosy yarn craft sessions with homemade bakes, coffee and plenty of encouragement.
primaryMessage: A colourful little place to learn, make and unwind.
shortWelcome: Learn to knit or crochet, make something seasonal, or settle in with a project. No experience necessary and all materials are provided.
importantMessage: Booking essential — sessions are limited to 12 people.
aboutBannerLead: Friendly, relaxed craft sessions for all ages and abilities.
aboutHeading: A café built around making things together.
aboutBody: The Craft Cafe hosts yarn-based sessions including learning to knit and crochet, baby clothes and blankets, seasonal home décor and more. Come for the craft and stay for the homemade cakes, cookies and drinks.
sessionsBannerLead: Small groups, materials included and no experience necessary.
foodBannerLead: Homemade bakes, coffee, tea and cold drinks whenever classes are running.
visitBannerLead: We open for booked craft sessions rather than general walk-ins.
bookingNote: Booking is essential. Class sizes are limited to 12.
foodNote: Dietary requirements can be accommodated. Bring your own mug if you like!
